rules.description: Employer must be registered with DBS or using an umbrella body
rules.reason_if_failed: You must register with DBS or use an umbrella body to request checks

rules.description: Check must be for England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: DBS checks only cover England and Wales. Use Disclosure Scotland or AccessNI for other UK nations.

rules.description: Basic checks are available for any role
rules.reason_if_failed: N/A - always passes for basic checks

rules.description: Standard checks require specified eligible roles
rules.reason_if_failed: This role is not eligible for a standard DBS check. You may only request a basic check.

rules.description: Enhanced checks require roles involving children or vulnerable adults
rules.reason_if_failed: Enhanced checks are only for roles involving work with children or vulnerable adults

rules.description: Employee must provide valid identity documents
rules.reason_if_failed: Employee must provide valid identity documents as specified in DBS guidance

rules.description: Self-employed or personal employees must request their own checks
rules.reason_if_failed: For self-employed or personal employees, the individual must request their own DBS check

edge_cases.description: Employee lived abroad and DBS check won't cover foreign time
edge_cases.action: Advise employer that DBS check only covers UK records. Employer must check criminal records in the country where employee lived.

edge_cases.description: Childminders can get checks through Ofsted
edge_cases.action: Redirect to Ofsted for childminder-specific DBS check process

edge_cases.description: Volunteers are eligible for free DBS checks
edge_cases.action: Apply volunteer pricing (£0.00) instead of standard fees

edge_cases.description: Care service employers can use DBS Adult First for faster initial clearance
edge_cases.action: Offer DBS Adult First service (additional £6) for supervised work clearance within 2 days
